items.heading: Most Fresher Profiles Are Written
items.text: Most fresher profiles are written to be read. Recruiter tools are built to be searched. That mismatch is the real reason a "complete" profile gets zero views.

items.heading: Linkedin Gives You 220 Characters
items.text: LinkedIn gives you 220 characters for a headline, but only the first 60-70 show up in most search results and on mobile. Whatever sits in that first stretch either gets you found or gets you skipped.

items.heading: Only the First Two
items.text: Only the first two to three lines of your About section show before someone has to click "see more." Most people never click. That means your first line is doing almost all the work, and starting it with "I am a final-year student pursuing B.Tech" wastes it on a fact your Education section already shows.
